The task succeeded after the child correctly tightened the screw, securing the door.

The caregiver corrected this by explaining that the measuring cup must be used for accuracy and demonstrated scooping sugar from the bowl into the measuring cup, then leveling it off with the knife. The task succeeded after the child followed the corrected steps.
